technique_name: Describe the differences between machine and deep learning
description: While both machine learning and deep learning are subfields of artificial intelligence, there are differences between the two. Machine learning algorithms rely on a series of manually crafted features and labeled data to train models. Deep learning models, on the other hand, are able to learn complex relationships between data points without the need for manual feature engineering.
